subpages.text: Login with Eistruttore Username or Email Address Password Remember Me Home About Us Services Our Services Conferences Secretariat Services Courses Certified Anti-Counterfeiting Practitioner (CACP) Certified OSINT & SOCMINT Practitioner (COSP) Counter Terrorism Behavioural Detection Officer (BDO) Regional Offices Gallery Careers Contact Our Corporate Secretariat and Secretarial (CSS) services span the entire spectrum of company business incorporation and formalisation. We provide advisory and assistance right from the formation of companies, initiation of business, regulatory registrations, banking, correspondences, accounting, auditing, taxation, annual submissions, local licensing, permit application and processing and office locational address with administrative support. We act for and on behalf of our clients inclusive of nominee directors to our clients’ businesses. As a CSS service organisation, we are a one stop centre to all services for our clients as their secretary and also their registered office at localities of their choice, if necessary. FGSS has built-in both international and country wide network of partners which enables us to extend our secretariat services to our clients and also their partners from overseas pertaining to the whole suit of services from formation to formal operations. Clients who aspire to take their businesses to foreign countries and wish to set up regional subsidiaries, joint ventures or fresh start-ups in such foreign land receive our advisory, consultation and administrative operational facilitations. We ensure that businesses we represent are legitimate, regulatory compliant and in good standing as we continuously engage for and on behalf of our clients.
